liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **West LA Fadeaway** (2 reviews): Reviewer enjoys the verve in West LA Fadeaway; West LA Fadeaway is rated a top-notch version [15][21]
- **Desolation Row** (2 reviews): Desolation Row is named as a personal highlight of the show; Reviewer was blown away by this Desolation Row, first heard on tape, and finds it even better streamed [13][19]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Mississippi Half-Step killer [22]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Hell In A Bucket is rated a top-notch version [21]
- **China Doll** (1 review): Jerry's solo in China Doll is singled out as cosmic and a highlight [13]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Throwing Stones is beautiful, especially the harmonies on the 'dizzy with eternity' line [21]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Black Muddy River suited as closer because a pond lay behind the stage, behind Jerry [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-05-10.142133.UltraMatrix.sbd.BHiFiM.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1987-05-10.165066.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [3]
- **gd1987-05-10.148844.sbd.waddell.ashley.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 157 min [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard with bass of this quality is rare [6]
- **gd1987-05-10.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83750.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 148 min; rated 3.46/5 by 13 [8]. Said about its sound: The stream sounds so good over a home stereo that the reviewer had to turn it up, drawing a police visit [22]
- **gd87-05-10.sbd.schneiderman.2256.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 3.54/5 by 13 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls overall quality excellent, but the Half-Step track won't decode properly or burn to an audio disc; The Half-Step shn file sounds harsh and screechy; converting it to wav cleaned it up but it wouldn't burn; Apart from problems on Half-Step, the soundboard is solid throughout [11][12][13][14][15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the first Laguna Seca run; the sun was brutal, maybe 95 in the shade, and he drank Sunkist by the board [14]
- Ry Cooder played first, followed by Bruce Hornsby and the Range, before the Dead [1]
- Bruce Hornsby and the Range opened the show [3]
- Bruce Hornsby and the Range opened the show [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-05-10.142133.UltraMatrix.sbd.BHiFiM.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Beta HiFi Master (Sony Betamax/TDK E-HG L-750) [1]. Also: UltraMatrix soundboard transfer provided as 16-bit 44.1 kHz FLAC [1]
- **gd1987-05-10.165066.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 3, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [3]. Also: Several masters were combined to make the show complete [3]
- **gd1987-05-10.148844.sbd.waddell.ashley.flac1644**: source: Bertha Remaster of source ID 137069 [6]. Also: Source credited to Jamie Waddell; remastered by an archive.org user in November 2016 [6]
- **gd1987-05-10.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83750.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90/Sony D5) [8]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Encore is placed at the end of the first set so the show fits two discs; second set rejoins seamlessly [8]
- **gd87-05-10.sbd.schneiderman.2256.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> PCM> DAT> zefiro2> soundforge> CDR> EAC> SHN [10]. Also: Described as a direct soundboard with no PCM generation in its lineage [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.gdao.org: [-- Eimon · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Grateful Dead Archive Online](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/811528) [24]
